title: Neer Garh Waterfall Rishikesh - Trekking, Nature & Travel Guide
content:
Neer Garh Waterfall - Rishikesh,

Neer Garh Waterfall (also called Neer Gaddu Waterfall) is one of the most beautiful natural attractions in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. Nestled in the lush Himalayan foothills, this cascading waterfall is a favorite spot for nature lovers, trekkers, and photographers.

The waterfall flows in multiple tiers, forming natural pools where visitors can take a refreshing dip. The trail to Neer Garh is a short trek (1-2 km) from the road, offering scenic views of the surrounding forests and valleys.

Its serene atmosphere, gushing waters, and untouched natural beauty make it a perfect getaway for those seeking peace away from the city’s hustle.

Best Time to Visit Neer Garh Waterfall Rishikesh:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Pleasant weather with temperatures 10°C - 25°C. Ideal for trekking, photography, and enjoying the cool waterfall streams.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm and sunny, with temperatures 20°C - 35°C. Great for short hikes and bathing in the pools, but carry water and sun protection.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon season with temperatures 18°C - 30°C. The waterfall is at its fullest and most stunning, but trekking paths can be slippery—caution required.

Things to Do at Neer Garh Waterfall:

  • Trek through feel green trails to reach the waterfall.
  • Enjoy a refreshing dip in the natural pools.
  • Capture stunning nature photography.
  • Relax in the peaceful surroundings with chirping birds and flowing water.
  • Stop at small local cafes along the trekking path for snacks and tea.

How to Reach Neer Garh Waterfall:

  • By Road: Located about 5-6 km from Laxman Jhula, reachable by taxi or scooter. From the parking spot, a short trek leads to the waterfall.
  • By Train: Rishikesh railway station (9 km away).
  • By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (28 km away).

Best Places to Visit Near Neer Garh Waterfall (within 50 km):

1- Laxman Jhula (6 km): Iconic suspension bridge.

2- Ram Jhula (8 km): Another hanging bridge with ashrams nearby.

3- Parmarth Niketan Ashram (8.5 km): Famous for yoga & Ganga Aarti.

4- Triveni Ghat (10 km): Evening Aarti and holy dips.

5- Beatles Ashram (7 km): Known for wall art and meditation domes.

6- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (25 km): Sacred temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.

7- Rajaji National Park (20 km - Chilla Gate): Jungle safaris & wildlife spotting.

8- Kunjapuri Temple (27 km): Sunrise point with panoramic views.

9- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar  (35 km): World-famous Ganga Aarti site.

10- Mansa Devi  & Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar (36-38 km): Ropeway-access Shakti Peeths.
excerpt: Neer Garh Waterfall Rishikesh is a scenic natural retreat surrounded by greenery, perfect for trekking, photography, and relaxation. With refreshing pools, a short hike, and proximity to other attractions, it’s a must-visit destination for adventure seekers and nature lovers in Uttarakhand.
